tenderSchedule.title: Tender for Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning and Service Support of P4 LED Video Wall for 11 Outdoor Gantries, including LED Video Wall Panels, Huidu Video Processor/Receiving Cards, MS Cabinets, FRC/Data cables, Fabrication, as per BoM at designated Gantry Locations, Electronics City, Bangalore - 560100, Karnataka.
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning and Service Support of P4 LED Video Wall for 11 Outdoor Gantries, including LED Video Wall Panels, Huidu Video Processor/Receiving Cards, MS Cabinets, FRC/Data cables, Fabrication, as per BoM at designated Gantry Locations, Electronics City, Bangalore - 560100, Karnataka.
tenderSchedule.locationName: ELCITA Chief Executive Officer Office Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Relevant Experience: The bidder should have implementation experience of supply, installation, testing and commissioning of outdoor LED Video Wall / LED Display Systems and associated fabrication works. Marks allocation: 30 Projects and above -30 marks, 20 Projects - 20 marks, 10 Projects - 10 marks, 5 Projects - 5 marks. Need to submit Completion Certificate Work Order / Agreement.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Use of innovative and advanced technology: Innovative and advanced LED display technology for best performance - 5 mark, value added services/features like displaying Air Quality and Weather reports, helping to enhance quality, reliability and maintainability of LED Video Wall - 5 marks.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Customer feedback: Customer feedback of similar LED Video Wall / LED Display deployment -2 marks of each customer, maximum 5 feedbacks.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical Requirements and Solution: Bidders understanding scope of the work as per ELCITA requirements - 10 Marks, Approach and Methodology - 5 Marks, Warranty / Working Guarantee - 5 Marks, One year - 1 mark, Two years - 3 marks, Three Year - 5 Marks, Technical Competency in LED Video Wall system - 5 Marks, Operation and Support Maintenance - 5 Marks.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Presentation to be given by the bidder at the time of evaluation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Company Financial Profile: The bidder should have an average annual turnover of Rs 50 lakhs for the last 3 financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26).1. Greater than or equal to Rs. 1.0 Cr 20 marks. 2. less than Rs. 1.0 Cr to Greater than or equal to Rs. 50 Lakhs 10 marks. 3. Less than or equal to Rs. 50 Lakhs to Greater than or equal to Rs. 25 lakhs 5 marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should be available for next 3 years, confirm by letter on letterhead.
Copy of applicable MAF / authorization from LED display manufacturer / OEM
